subject: Important Update: New Payment Process
body: Dear valued customers, we are writing to inform you about our new payment process that will be effective starting next month. In order to streamline our operations and provide you with a better payment experience, we have updated our payment portal. You will receive an email with detailed instructions on how to navigate the new system. If you encounter any issues or have questions, please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
